Warren Calls for AI Regulation
On Saturday, in a post on
X
, Warren said Congress should focus on passing legislation rather than creating additional committees or continuing lengthy debates over AI.
"Congress cannot meet the pressing threat of AI by just forming another committee or continuing to have drawn-out discussions about it," she said.
She urged lawmakers to move toward concrete regulatory measures, adding, "Let’s actually pass some meaningful regulations on AI to protect people."
